metadata.note: Domain cards the engine can run as player abilities. Keys are card names from the embedded domain data, or Book: Spell for a grimoire spell. Effects use the feature mapping schema, with target_type self/ally/allies for heals and clears. Approximations are spelled out in note. proficiency_dice rolls the PC's Proficiency in dice of the formula's size; scale_by multiplies an amount or dice count by level, tier, proficiency, spellcast (the PC's Spellcast trait) or a trait. roll_trait names the trait an ability rolls with: spells default to spellcast, everything else to the weapon trait. A passive with no trigger is always on (its trigger_filter says while what); one that uses tokens only while it holds some. The triggers on_damage_roll, on_damage_incoming and on_attacked pay their cost to change that one roll or hit.
